sourceType: Image-tool generated derivative of the user-supplied character, not native 3D morphs.

fullPrompts.initial:
Use case: identity-preserve, anime visual novel character sprite atlas.
Input image 1 is the exact character identity and costume reference: the supplied transparent front standing portrait of the blue-haired fish girl. Create one polished hand-drawn anime visual novel expression-and-pose sprite sheet of THIS SAME character, with nine separate full cutouts, in a strict 3 columns by 3 rows equal-cell grid. The whole canvas should be portrait 4:5, ideally 1536 x 1920 pixels or higher, each cell 512 x 640 if using that size. Actual transparent alpha background, including all empty space between characters. No background, checkerboard, gradients, tile backgrounds, ground shadows, borders, grid lines, panel captions, text, symbols, hearts, watermarks or extra props.
IDENTITY AND CLOTHING INVARIANTS: same apparent age and proportions as the reference, same large blue eyes, long deep-blue hair with cyan-blue lower strands, distinctive outward fish-fin ears, small single ahoge, white frilled maid headband, blue-and-white modest long-sleeved maid dress with existing gold edging and tiny button details, neck bow and white apron. Preserve the exact costume silhouette and decorations without inventing new ornaments or changing coverage. This is a nonsexual everyday character portrait.
LAYOUT CRITICAL: exactly nine isolated copies, one centered within each identical cell, same frontal camera, same head size, same top-of-head position, same eye-line and shoulder position in every cell. Fixed framing from the top of the ahoge to upper thighs / lower skirt as in the reference. Head centered around 50% of each cell's width; top of ahoge around 5% down; eyes around 23% down. Leave generous empty transparent margins left and right, no hair, fin or hand crossing a cell boundary. Keep the full head, hair tips, both arms and visible hands inside their own cell. All nine figures at identical scale; subtle expressive pose only below the shoulders. Keep consistent face identity, high quality clean line art and soft detailed cel shading across all panels.
Reading order MUST be left-to-right then top-to-bottom, exactly:
row 1 col 1 NEUTRAL / calm: open attentive eyes, relaxed eyebrows, small neutral closed mouth, both arms comfortably lowered.
row 1 col 2 HAPPY: visibly bright smiling eyes and raised cheeks, cheerful open smile, hands gently held together at chest without overlapping or fused fingers.
row 1 col 3 SAD: inner brows clearly raised, slightly downcast eyes, small downturned mouth, shoulders mildly softened, hands resting low in front.
row 2 col 1 ANGRY: eyebrows distinctly angled down toward center, firm direct gaze, small displeased mouth, one hand gently set at waist; keep it natural and mild.
row 2 col 2 SURPRISED: clearly wider open eyes and raised brows, small rounded open mouth, one open hand raised near chest; anatomically correct fingers.
row 2 col 3 SHY: blush on cheeks, slightly averted eyes, small hesitant closed smile, hands held modestly near chest, no hand overlap.
row 3 col 1 THINKING: thoughtful asymmetrical brows and slight sideward gaze, closed mouth, one hand lightly near chin with naturally bent index finger.
row 3 col 2 SERIOUS: focused steady eyes, level slightly lowered brows, composed unsmiling lips, arms lowered in a controlled relaxed stance.
row 3 col 3 RELIEVED: gently closed smiling eyes, relaxed brows, soft small smile, one hand resting lightly over upper chest.
Each face must be visibly and meaningfully different: expressive eyebrows, eyes and mouth, not only different body poses. Clean correct arms, wrists and fingers; no crossed or intersecting forearms, no fused hands, no extra fingers. Preserve identity and equal layout, with no other subjects. Render exactly one transparent PNG sprite atlas.
fullPrompts.framingCorrection:
Edit the FIRST reference image, which is the generated nine-panel expression atlas. The SECOND reference is only the original character identity/costume guide. Keep the first image's exact blue-haired fish-ear girl's identity, hand-drawn anime style, blue-white maid costume, all nine expressions and their row-major order (neutral, happy, sad / angry, surprised, shy / thinking, serious, relieved). Fix ONLY the layout and framing problem: all nine portraits are currently too close to cell boundaries and some hands are cut off.
Produce the corrected single PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA, 3 columns x 3 rows of exactly equal rectangular cells, total 4:5 canvas preferably 1536 x 1920. No lines or visible cell boundaries, no text, no background, no checkerboard, no shadows.
Within EVERY cell put ONE complete top-of-head-to-upper-thigh portrait at IDENTICAL SCALE, frontal torso orientation and identical head center and eye-line. Shrink the figure enough to comfortably fit ALL fish-fin ears, hair and both hands with at least 7% transparent horizontal clearance on EACH SIDE of its cell, and 6% transparent clearance above the ahoge. The lower crop can end at upper thighs / lower skirt, like the original second image, but must NOT cut through any fingers or wrists. Keep the same small uniform transparent gap between rows. No pixel of one figure may enter any neighboring cell. Uniform head sizes and placement across all nine cells. Preserve true clean alpha around hair strands, no bright matte or white edge halo.
The nine expressions must remain easy to tell apart. Keep natural anatomically correct hands. Neutral and serious have arms lowered close to body; happy's two hands lightly meet without fused fingers; sad's hands rest low; angry one hand at waist; surprised one hand at chest; shy both hands near upper chest; thinking one finger by chin, other arm lowered rather than crossed; relieved one hand lightly over upper chest. The character's entire visible outfit is modest and unchanged. Do not add any accessories, objects, symbols, labels or additional characters. This is an atlas layout correction, not a character redesign.
fullPrompts.spacingCorrection:
Correct this sprite atlas's SPACING ONLY. Keep all nine character faces, expressions, outfits and hand poses as pictured. Output one 3 by 3 grid of the SAME nine blue-haired fish-ear maid character cutouts on REAL transparent alpha background. Overall canvas portrait 4:5, exactly equal cells. Reading order is neutral/happy/sad; angry/surprised/shy; thinking/serious/relieved.
The present atlas is packed too tightly and figures overlap cell boundaries. THIS MUST BE FIXED: make every whole figure MUCH SMALLER, occupying ONLY the CENTRAL 65 PERCENT of its cell width and CENTRAL 80 PERCENT of its cell height. Keep huge empty transparent padding: about 17.5% on left AND right, 10% at top AND bottom OF EACH CELL. There must be wide, continuous, entirely empty transparent gutters between columns and rows. All nine head sizes equal; all nine heads at the exact same relative location inside each cell. Show the whole referenced head-to-lower-skirt cutout including both hands, as already present. Leave the blank padding; do NOT zoom to fill it and do NOT auto-crop the canvas.
Important: transparent horizontal stripe at every row boundary and transparent vertical stripe at every column boundary. These empty gutters are required by a game engine, not optional compositional decoration. No outlines, tiles, grids, captions, symbols, background colors, checkerboard or shadows. No new objects. Keep the identity, clothing and each existing facial expression unchanged. Do not redraw the characters larger to fill the available space; smaller sprites and large transparent gutters are the goal.

framingNote: Generated placement is not an equal 3x3 pixel grid. Use the explicit frame rectangles, same 336x420 size for every emotion; do not split by thirds.
